output.summary: A tender shrub or small tree native to southeastern Brazil and thought extinct in the wild, it bears large, hanging trumpet-shaped flowers that are sweetly scented at night and in the early morning. Every part is poisonous, especially the seeds and leaves, and ingestion can cause severe effects including hallucinations, paralysis and death.
output.edibilityNote: Every part is poisonous when ingested; seeds and leaves are especially dangerous.
